limitations: No executable driver/runtime provided or tested.
No pinned SDK hook/provider/IAM/TLS/private route/usage/idempotency verification.
Traceability validation is not runtime/security acceptance.

threats.title: Forged IPC
threats.attack: Forged execute/deploy messages and content-derived approval flags.
threats.mitigation: Closed versioned IPC schemas, panel-bound nonce, host-issued action identity, current scope validation and host-only policy/secrets; UI expresses intent, never authority.
threats.residual_risk: Host compromise exceeds this perimeter.

threats.title: Active rendered content
threats.attack: HTML/SVG scripts and command links invoke host or steal data.
threats.mitigation: Restrictive CSP, bundled nonced scripts only, no eval/remote scripts, escaped text/sanitized Markdown; deny command/file/javascript/data URI navigation and review external destinations through host.
threats.residual_risk: Sanitizer/browser bugs and deceptive text remain.

threats.title: Untrusted workspace execution
threats.attack: Repository config auto-launches MCP, startup hooks or generated code.
threats.mitigation: Workspace Trust AND separate reviewed immutable executable/argv/env/cwd/config mandate; no auto-run/install or workspace-controlled secret resolution. Revoke on trust/config change.
threats.residual_risk: Trusted repository/dependency can still be malicious.

threats.title: Injection grants tools
threats.attack: Tool/model content grants itself shell, secret or unlimited budget authority.
threats.mitigation: Treat output/prompt/workspace as tainted data; independent host mandate with trusted effect classification and argument/tool/destination allowlists on every dispatch.
threats.residual_risk: Allowed tools can be abused semantically within narrow grants.

threats.title: Credential transport confusion
threats.attack: Wrong-purpose credential/header or child env forwarding.
threats.mitigation: Bind reference to connection/credential generation/organization/purpose/destination. Control plane alone uses X-Auth-Token; inference alone uses Authorization: Bearer, never both/query/userinfo/tool env.
threats.residual_risk: Live IAM misconfiguration/provider compromise needs external controls.

threats.title: Redirect credential exfiltration
threats.attack: Returned endpoint/redirect targets attacker, wrong port, path or userinfo.
threats.mitigation: Exact canonical reviewed HTTPS origin/path/method; endpoint API return is candidate data, not authority. Disable redirects on credential/effect requests; never forward auth to a destination transition.
threats.residual_risk: Approved compromised destination may misuse intended credentials.

threats.title: TLS/private endpoint bypass
threats.attack: Invalid TLS or unreachable private route prompts verify=false/public fallback.
threats.mitigation: Validate chain/expiry/hostname, no global bypass. Reviewed custom CA only exact private destination; private reachability is unknown until verified, no silent public fallback.
threats.residual_risk: Approved CA compromise/topology needs separate verification.

threats.title: SSRF and DNS rebinding
threats.attack: Metadata/private/loopback/IPv6 targets or rebinding escape initial allowlist.
threats.mitigation: Strict URL/IP normalization; default deny metadata/link-local/loopback/private/reserved/protocol/proxy targets; check DNS and connected peer every attempt with pinning/equivalent enforcement. Private exception exact reviewed route, never metadata/runtime.
threats.residual_risk: If transport cannot enforce peer checks, fail closed; compromised approved server remains risk.

threats.title: Cross-scope caches
threats.attack: Scope B displays pending/cached resources or clients from A.
threats.mitigation: Partition by connection, credential generation, organization/project/region, endpoint/capability version; invalidate pending work/client pools on switch/rotation; label stale data.
threats.residual_risk: Provider scope inaccuracies require actual API/IAM evidence.

threats.title: Late/forged/replayed events
threats.attack: Cancelled A overwrites B or duplicate usage inflates metrics.
threats.mitigation: Host-issued immutable scope/run/attempt/session/spec/prompt/model/data/epoch identities, schema/sequence validation, replay dedup and segregated partial history.
threats.residual_risk: Provider ordering/usage may be unavailable; report unknown honestly.

threats.title: Secret leaks in evidence
threats.attack: Headers/env/nested errors or stderr contain credentials.
threats.mitigation: Redact structurally before serialization, recursively/case-insensitively; secret-tainted data never enters events. Scrub request dumps/stderr/query and known values; exports use references, default traces minimize content, no unsolicited telemetry.
threats.residual_risk: Pattern matching alone cannot guarantee arbitrary secret detection.

threats.title: Unconsented data transmission
threats.attack: Read .env or attachments implicitly sent onward.
threats.mitigation: Separate minimized snapshot/digest/file-range/recipient/purpose consent; exclude secret files, renew after mutation/destination change. Read authority is not onward transmission authority.
threats.residual_risk: Approved data can still contain undiscovered sensitive content.

threats.title: Missing pre-effect Strands gate
threats.attack: Post-effect hook, nested/parallel/retry path bypasses policy.
threats.mitigation: Pin SDK and prove true pre-effect interception for all paths; policy error/missing coverage denies. Effect adapters gate model sends and tools including internal retries/children; Strands owns loop, no duplicate orchestration.
threats.residual_risk: Actual release/hook semantics UNVERIFIED; block effectful runtime until integration evidence.

threats.title: Parallel overspend
threats.attack: Two workers race on remaining budget or judge bypasses parent limits.
threats.mitigation: Shared durable atomic reservation/lock/CAS for parent/children, requests/steps/tokens/concurrency/time/money; reserve worst-case exposure before send, idempotent settlement.
threats.residual_risk: Provider pricing/usage divergence needs provider/account hard controls too.

threats.title: Unknown usage considered free
threats.attack: Missing/malformed/duplicate cumulative usage frees exposure.
threats.mitigation: Unknown price/uncomputable hard upper exposure denies before send. Missing usage retains reservation and freezes affected spending until reconciliation; validate finite bounded nonnegative integer usage and monotonic/delta semantics.
threats.residual_risk: Authoritative usage may never arrive; manual reconciliation can limit availability.

threats.title: Revocation race
threats.attack: Queued action runs after revoke or old epoch retries.
threats.mitigation: Monotonic epoch and revoke barrier serialized with final dispatch transition; recheck trust/scope/grant immediately pre-effect, reject queued/nested/stale work. Local cancel does not roll back prior sent effects.
threats.residual_risk: Already accepted remote effect cannot be unsent.

threats.title: Unknown effect blind retry
threats.attack: Timeout duplicates inference charges or provisioned resources.
threats.mitigation: Durable intent/attempt and supported idempotency identity; prepared/sent/accepted/proven/unknown states. Approved read-only reconciliation before retry; no auto-replay unknown non-idempotent effects.
threats.residual_risk: No provider lookup/idempotency means blocked unknown and reviewed manual recovery.

threats.title: Loopback hijack
threats.attack: Tokenless/cross-origin or DNS-rebinding call launches tools.
threats.mitigation: Explicit loopback bind/random port, per-instance high-entropy host-held capability on all routes/SSE; reject Host/Origin mismatch/wildcard CORS, bound body/rate; webview talks via host only.
threats.residual_risk: Same-user malware/host compromise exceeds loopback capability defense.

threats.title: MCP identity/config drift
threats.attack: Read tool rebound to shell or remote endpoint after grant.
threats.mitigation: Bind executable/server/transport/version/config/tool schema/effect digests and destinations; change invalidates grant, unknown/duplicate tools denied. Restrict env/files/network with trusted adapter/sandbox not server description.
threats.residual_risk: Approved malicious server can lie; classification needs enforcement.

threats.title: Filesystem/shell escape
threats.attack: Traversal/symlink race or interpolation escapes approved root.
threats.mitigation: Resolved roots checked at effect time, descriptor/sandbox confinement and atomic safe write; argv without implicit shell, overwrite diff/review, exports never auto-execute.
threats.residual_risk: Platform races need native evidence; explicitly approved shell remains broad power.

threats.title: External session leak/replay
threats.attack: Shared ID crosses tenant, stored approval revives old mandate.
threats.mitigation: Explicit authenticated scoped adapter, namespace/encryption/access/retention, schema/integrity/CAS; no secrets or active authority serialized. Resume fresh authorization and unknown-effect reconciliation; memory not durability.
threats.residual_risk: Store operator compromise/outage and persistence topology require evidence.

threats.title: Approval escalation
threats.attack: Discovery/create-agent permission reused to deploy/publish/delete/EULA.
threats.mitigation: Separate exact reviewed action/account/project/region/resources/network/EULA/cost/cleanup grants. GET/inference/local prepare never confer provisioning/registry/publish/commit/sync.
threats.residual_risk: Human mistaken approval still possible; least privilege and clear review needed.

threats.title: Evaluation false success/judge authority
threats.attack: Partial/cancelled counted success or judge implicitly makes paid calls/grants tools.
threats.mitigation: Typed terminal/effect states, partial/error/unknown separately labelled/excluded; provenance, separate judge/data approval and parent atomic budget; judge text never changes policy/deterministic metrics.
threats.residual_risk: Judges are probabilistic/biased; deterministic/human checks still needed.

threats.title: Implicit provider/telemetry fallback
threats.attack: Missing config chooses default provider, env proxy routes auth or auto-tracing uploads.
threats.mitigation: Pinned provider/client versions with explicit Scaleway base URL/model/external ref, no default provider/credential discovery; egress allowlist covers dependencies/retries/proxies, disable unsolicited telemetry.
threats.residual_risk: Compromised dependency may bypass in-process controls; OS egress/isolation needed.

threats.title: Resource exhaustion/retry storm
threats.attack: Oversized messages/infinite streams/429 consume CPU/spend.
threats.mitigation: Bound payload/queue/output/time/steps, retry attempt/deadline/backoff caps and reserve every send; no retry on revoke/unknown send.
threats.residual_risk: Service may still deny availability; bounded output deliberately truncates.

threats.title: Crash loses reservations/authority
threats.attack: In-memory budget vanishes with charge pending; old session resumes.
threats.mitigation: Journal durable reservation/intent/epoch before dispatch; crash recovery preserves unknown exposure, rotates capability and reauthorizes. Corrupt/unavailable ledger fails closed; multi-worker shared durable state required.
threats.residual_risk: Disk/provider evidence loss may need manual recovery, not rollback fiction.
